TST-0113.evidence_requirement: the verbatim message for every triggered error path with a rubric score per part; scores assigned against the captured text, not from reading the source
TST-0113.question_or_target: Phase 5 requires 'clear user-facing error messages' (:10840). Target: trigger every error path and score its message against a three-part rubric (what failed, why, what to do). A message that only says an operation failed is a defect, not a style preference.
TST-0113.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after the 2nd failure on the same error-fingerprint, enumerate >=2 alternative approaches before a 3rd attempt (AGENTS.md 4b)
TST-0113.reviewer_requirement: two fresh-context reviewers: one cross-vendor refuter and one Windows-platform specialist who re-runs the probe in the OTHER shell (PowerShell 7 vs Git Bash)
tests_required: test_every_error_path_is_triggered_at_least_once
test_each_message_scores_on_all_three_rubric_parts
TST-0113.title: User-facing error messages must name the component, the cause and the remedy

TST-0124.evidence_requirement: the suite x gate join table with the ungated count; the join must be proven by showing a known-gated suite appearing on the gated side
TST-0124.question_or_target: Measured on this estate: 162 of 244 suites ran in NO CI gate, and every triage lane that looked inside that set found a live bug. Target: enumerate suites and gates, join them, and report the ungated set. A suite nobody runs is not coverage.
TST-0124.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after the 2nd failure on the same error-fingerprint, enumerate >=2 alternative approaches before a 3rd attempt (AGENTS.md 4b)
TST-0124.reviewer_requirement: one fresh-context adversarial reviewer from the OTHER vendor than the author (Claude author -> Codex reviewer, and the reverse); a same-vendor reviewer inherits the author's blind spots
tests_required: test_every_suite_is_classified_gated_or_ungated
test_a_known_gated_suite_is_correctly_joined (control)
test_ungated_suites_are_listed_by_path
TST-0124.title: CI-gate census: every test suite must map to a gate that can turn red

TST-0129.evidence_requirement: two mechanically independent signals: (a) the process exit code plus stderr text, and (b) a pre/post sha256 of the on-disk index directory taken by a separate process; plus the both-states transcript showing the same assertion passing on a resolvable host
TST-0129.question_or_target: When DNS resolution for the marketplace registry host fails, does `install` abort with an actionable error and leave ZERO bytes of index written, or does it fall back to a partial / previously cached index and report success? PASS requires: non-zero exit, an error naming the host and the resolver, and a byte-for-byte unchanged index file.
TST-0129.retry_policy: up to 3 attempts with full-jitter backoff; a flake rate above 1-in-20 reruns is filed as a DEFECT against the test, never absorbed as a retry
TST-0129.reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial reviewer in a fresh context who did not author the harness under test
tests_required: both-states control: assertion fires with the resolver blackholed and is silent on a reachable registry
postcondition probe: index directory sha256 identical before and after the failed install
TST-0129.title: DNS failure during registry fetch fails closed

TST-0130.evidence_requirement: two independent signals: (a) client exit classification, and (b) a passive capture of the attempted connections proving no second connection to an http:// scheme or port 80 occurred
TST-0130.question_or_target: With an expired / wrong-CN certificate presented by the registry endpoint, does the client refuse the connection outright? PASS requires: no plaintext HTTP retry on any port, no `--insecure` equivalent reachable from config, and no silent substitution of a cached index for the refused fetch.
TST-0130.retry_policy: up to 3 attempts with full-jitter backoff; a flake rate above 1-in-20 reruns is filed as a DEFECT against the test, never absorbed as a retry
TST-0130.reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial reviewer in a fresh context who did not author the harness under test
tests_required: both-states control: a valid certificate on the same fixture endpoint must pass
negative control: a config that attempts to set insecure-TLS must be rejected at parse time
TST-0130.title: TLS handshake failure must not downgrade to plaintext

TST-0136.evidence_requirement: two independent signals: (a) dispatch timestamps recorded by the harness, and (b) the server fixture's own arrival log; the two clocks must be reconciled and the reconciliation shown
TST-0136.question_or_target: Does the client honor `Retry-After` when expressed as delta-seconds AND as an HTTP-date? PASS requires the observed next-attempt time to fall inside the instructed window for both forms, including a date already in the past (immediate retry) and a malformed value (fall back to backoff, do not crash).
TST-0136.retry_policy: up to 3 attempts with full-jitter backoff; a flake rate above 1-in-20 reruns is filed as a DEFECT against the test, never absorbed as a retry
TST-0136.reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial reviewer in a fresh context who did not author the harness under test
tests_required: both-states control: a client that ignores Retry-After must fail all four cases
property test over 200 generated Retry-After values including negative, zero, huge and malformed
TST-0136.title: Retry-After is honored in both wire formats

TST-0137.evidence_requirement: two independent signals: (a) per-request dispatch timestamps binned into 1-second buckets, and (b) the fixture server's independently recorded arrival count; the two must agree within 1%
TST-0137.question_or_target: Release 256 units at t=0 and measure the observed arrival rate at the vendor boundary. Does the scheduler's stagger/jitter keep the measured rate under the configured ceiling? PASS requires the rate be measured from DISPATCH TIMESTAMPS at the boundary, never read back from the config value.
TST-0137.retry_policy: up to 3 attempts with full-jitter backoff; a flake rate above 1-in-20 reruns is filed as a DEFECT against the test, never absorbed as a retry
TST-0137.reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial reviewer in a fresh context who did not author the harness under test
tests_required: detector control: run with the stagger disabled and confirm the measurement reports a ceiling breach, proving the meter can see one
both-states control: stagger enabled must be silent
TST-0137.title: Arrival-rate ceiling holds under a 256-unit simultaneous release

TST-0138.evidence_requirement: two independent signals: (a) empirical interval samples across 50 runs, and (b) a symbolic or exhaustive check over the backoff function proving the bound for all attempt counts
TST-0138.question_or_target: Are retry intervals non-deterministic across runs (full jitter) while the SUM of the retry budget is provably less than the unit's `timeout_seconds`? PASS requires: interval sets from two runs differ, and no generated schedule exceeds the timeout for any configured max-attempts.
TST-0138.retry_policy: up to 3 attempts with full-jitter backoff; a flake rate above 1-in-20 reruns is filed as a DEFECT against the test, never absorbed as a retry
TST-0138.reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial reviewer in a fresh context who did not author the harness under test
tests_required: property test: for all (base, cap, attempts) in the supported ranges, sum(schedule) < timeout
negative control: a fixed-interval (unjittered) implementation must fail the non-determinism assertion
TST-0138.title: Backoff is jittered, bounded, and cannot outlive the unit timeout

TST-0139.evidence_requirement: two independent signals: (a) the concurrency counter sampled during the injected 529 storm, and (b) the per-unit classification recorded in the ledger
TST-0139.question_or_target: Does the harness distinguish a 429 (our arrival rate) from a 529 / vendor-overload (their capacity) and apply different policies? PASS requires: 429 reduces our arrival rate; 529 does NOT reduce program concurrency and instead retries the affected unit while siblings continue.
TST-0139.retry_policy: up to 3 attempts with full-jitter backoff; a flake rate above 1-in-20 reruns is filed as a DEFECT against the test, never absorbed as a retry
TST-0139.reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial reviewer in a fresh context who did not author the harness under test
tests_required: both-states control: an injected 429 storm MUST reduce arrival rate; an injected 529 storm must not - a harness that behaves identically for both fails
negative control: mislabelling 529 as 429 must be detectable by this test
TST-0139.title: 429 and 529 are different policies, and 529 must not shrink concurrency

TST-0141.evidence_requirement: two independent signals: (a) an invariant assertion inside the bucket, and (b) an external audit of the issued-permit log recomputing the window totals after the fact
TST-0141.question_or_target: Under 64 concurrent takers, can the token bucket ever go negative or issue more permits than its capacity in any window? PASS requires zero violations across a randomized property run and a deterministic replay of any counterexample.
TST-0141.retry_policy: up to 3 attempts with full-jitter backoff; a flake rate above 1-in-20 reruns is filed as a DEFECT against the test, never absorbed as a retry
TST-0141.reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial reviewer in a fresh context who did not author the harness under test
tests_required: property test with 10,000 randomized interleavings; any counterexample must shrink to a minimal reproducing schedule
mutation control: remove the lock/CAS and confirm the property fails
TST-0141.title: Token-bucket accounting is race-free under N concurrent takers

TST-0142.evidence_requirement: two independent signals: (a) the barrier's returned object compared against the launch manifest, and (b) an independent count of receipt files on disk
TST-0142.question_or_target: When half a cohort is 429-blocked at the barrier, does fan-in return a typed PARTIAL naming every blocked unit id? PASS requires the denominator stay at the launched count; a result reporting 'N of N complete' after silently dropping blocked units is a FAIL.
TST-0142.retry_policy: up to 3 attempts with full-jitter backoff; a flake rate above 1-in-20 reruns is filed as a DEFECT against the test, never absorbed as a retry
TST-0142.reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial reviewer in a fresh context who did not author the harness under test
tests_required: both-states control: an unblocked cohort returns COMPLETE with the same denominator
negative control: a barrier that filters blocked units out of its own denominator must fail
TST-0142.title: Rate-limited partial fan-in returns typed PARTIAL, never a shrunken denominator

TST-0143.evidence_requirement: two independent signals: (a) the predicate's returned condition vector, and (b) an independent stat() of the file size
TST-0143.question_or_target: Does completion-predicate condition 3 (non-empty and above a meaningful minimum) reject a 0-byte artifact while accepting a legitimately small one at exactly the declared floor? PASS requires both directions.
TST-0143.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot (AGENTS.md 4b): after the second failure on the same hypothesis, enumerate >=2 alternative approaches before a third attempt
TST-0143.reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial reviewer in a fresh context who did not author the harness under test
tests_required: both-states control: 0 bytes fails, floor-sized passes
boundary test at floor-1, floor, floor+1
TST-0143.title: Zero-byte artifact fails the minimum-size condition

TST-0144.evidence_requirement: two independent signals: (a) the parse error with byte offset, and (b) an inspection of the consumer's cache showing no entry for the artifact id
TST-0144.question_or_target: When an artifact is non-empty but truncated mid-JSON, does condition 4 fail AND does no downstream consumer retain a partially-parsed object? PASS requires the parse cache to hold no entry for that artifact after the failure.
TST-0144.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot (AGENTS.md 4b): after the second failure on the same hypothesis, enumerate >=2 alternative approaches before a third attempt
TST-0144.reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial reviewer in a fresh context who did not author the harness under test
tests_required: both-states control: the complete artifact parses and caches
negative control: a lenient parser that repairs truncated JSON must fail this test
TST-0144.title: Truncated JSON fails schema parse and is never cached as parsed
